body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> XtremeMac, a leading designer and manufacturer of accessories and audio solutions for Apple devices, is pleased to announce its stylish and protective cases for the 4th generation iPod touch and 6th generation nano are now available just in time for the holiday season. These new case lines allow access to all ports, jacks and new features for the recently announced iPod models.
The iPod touch 6th generation cases include the signature Tuffwrap silicone case line, Microshield plastic impact-resistant case line and Hybrid two-piece plastic and silicone design cases.

The Sportwrap, available for the new iPod nano and touch, is a high-performance, lightweight armband designed for the active iPod user. It is constructed with soft, durable lycra and neoprene, protects from sweat and keeps the device securely in place during workouts.

Also available for both the iPod 6th generation touch and 4th generation nano is the Tuffshield screen protectors, made with state of the art materials and formulated to create the best protection from scratches.
The XtremeMac iPod touch and nano cases and shields range from $12.99 to $29.99 U.S. MSRP at www.XtremeMac.com.
